results.title: Moti
results.overview: After an unexpected visit, 84-year-old Nami opens up to her granddaughter Midori, revealing long-buried family secrets and childhood traumas from 1940s Brazil. At the same time, she watches her other grandson, Jun, become consumed by the hatred of political polarization. It's election day. Past and present, life and death, East and West, left and right all merge within this family, much like a moti, a traditional Japanese sweet.

results.title: Moti
results.overview: At the start of the pandemic, a family in Kolkata discovers their pet dog Moti has turned into a boy - leading to a journey of ridiculous science and absurd evolution, all in search of a new normal.

results.title: Anmol Moti (Precious Pearl)
results.overview: A village head's son's accidental death in the sea forces the government to ban fishermen from diving in search of pearls. However, the ban obstructs the main occupation of the villagers.

results.name: Bikhray Moti
results.overview: ‘Bikhray Moti’ is the story of a young girl, Aiza who has dreams of making a better future for herself. But fate has something else in store for her, a promise to her dying sister takes her on a completely different path, and her mission becomes saving the lives of her nephews and niece from their heartless father, Zulfi and the evils of the society.

results.title: Scattered Pearls
results.overview: A young widow is separated from her two sons, but rescues and raises a rich man's daughter.

known_for.title: Meghmallar
known_for.overview: A touching story of a simple man caught up in the terror of 1971 Bangladesh.

known_for.title: Affliction
known_for.overview: Director: Sheikh Niamat Ali  Writers: Sheikh Niamat Ali (dialogue), Sheikh Niamat Ali (screenplay) |  Stars: Humayun Faridi, Bobita, Dolly Anowar

known_for.title: And She Was Beautiful
known_for.overview: Sundori is a young woman from a poor family in a village governed by a ruthless zamindar.

known_for.title: Sukanya Savitri
known_for.overview: This film tells two independent stories from the Mahabharata. The first part features the princess Savitri, who stands by her husband, the woodcutter Satyavan, when he is marked by Yama, the god of Death. When Yama fulfills his prophecy and takes away Satyavan's life, Savitri pleads with him and eventually wins her husband back. There are extraordinary scenes showing Savitri's pleas with the god sitting astride a buffalo somewhere between heaven and earth, intercut with shots of the couple's idyllic life as Savitri tends to her blind parents-in-law. The second half narrates the legend of Sukanya, the daughter of Sharyati. Seeing a large ant-hill, and unaware that it has been built over the meditating sage Chyvana, she blinds the sage and, in return, is forced to marry him. She tends to the old and decrepit man, and he changes into a handsome youth.

known_for.title: Gul-e-Bakavali
known_for.overview: Based on a popular legend, this silent film tells the story of the fairy Bakavali and her divine flower, the Gul, which possesses healing powers. Taj-ul-Mulk, a prince from the East, seeks the flower to cure his blind father. The legend's origins are debated: one version traces it to a 19th-century translation of a Persian tale, while another points to a 16th-century narrative from Abely Sheikh. The story was a favorite on the Parsee stage, particularly the scenes where Taj-ul-Mulk battles his villainous brothers, who steal the flower. The tale also features Bakavali turning to stone and her eventual human rebirth.

known_for.title: The Divine Punishment
known_for.overview: A silent social drama exploring themes of treason and retribution. The film would have told a moralistic tale about a character who acts as an "enemy of the nation" and faces divine or karmic punishment for their actions.

known_for.title: Chachchu Amar Chachchu
known_for.overview: Rafique Mallik is a honest judge. Someone tries to kill his son Rafat, as revenge against Rafique. Rafat survives, but the perpetrator won’t easily stop his campaign of terror against the family.

known_for.title: Ek Takar Bou
known_for.overview: Two sisters fall for the same man. Their lives, however, turn into a tragedy after the women find the man cheating on them.

known_for.title: Peeping Toms
known_for.overview: Gote and Eli are two aging friends who don't want to age. Gote is a lifeguard who's fighting peepers on the Jaffa  ̶T̶e̶l̶ ̶A̶v̶i̶v̶  beach. Eli is a guitar player who dreams of building a night club in altman's restaurant.

known_for.title: My Michael
known_for.overview: Based on a novel by Amos Oz. A couple in Jerusalem before the six day war in 1967, fall in love, get married, have a child and drift apart. With Michael away at war, his wife starts fantasizing about twin Arabs she used to play with as a child.

known_for.title: Save the Lifeguard
known_for.overview: Comedy about day to day life of a Gordon beach lifeguard and his friends.

known_for.title: Baadal
known_for.overview: Baadal has a bitter rivalry with Thakur Kiran Singh, who plans to usurp his land to avenge his father's death. However, when Kiran's sister Meenakshi falls for Baadal, it creates complications.

known_for.title: Rabba Main Kya Karoon
known_for.overview: Rabba Main Kya Karoon is a roller coaster ride, which centres around a big - lavish Delhi wedding.

known_for.title: The Delta Force
known_for.overview: A 707 aircraft jetliner, en route from Athens to Rome and then to New York City, is hijacked by Lebanese terrorists, who demand that the pilot take them to Beirut. What the terrorists don't realize is that an elite team of commandos have been called in to eliminate all terrorists on the jetliner.

known_for.title: The Little Drummer Girl
known_for.overview: An American actress with a penchant for lying is forceably recruited by Mossad, the Israeli intelligence agency, to trap a Palestinian bomber, by pretending to be the girlfriend of his dead brother.

known_for.title: The Ambassador
known_for.overview: An American ambassador to Israel tries to bring peace to the Middle East conflict through unconventional methods, but his efforts are hampered at every turn and his personal life threatened.

known_for.title: Jesus
known_for.overview: Three and a half years of Jesus' ministry, as told in the Gospel of Luke.

known_for.title: Marry Me
known_for.overview: After finding out about her fiancé's cheating ways, a pop superstar impulsively marries a total stranger. They must soon decide if two people from such different worlds can find true love.

known_for.name: The Blacklist
known_for.overview: Raymond "Red" Reddington, one of the FBI's most wanted fugitives, surrenders in person at FBI Headquarters in Washington, D.C. He claims that he and the FBI have the same interests: bringing down dangerous criminals and terrorists. In the last two decades, he's made a list of criminals and terrorists that matter the most but the FBI cannot find because it does not know they exist. Reddington calls this "The Blacklist". Reddington will co-operate, but insists that he will speak only to Elizabeth Keen, a rookie FBI profiler.

known_for.name: The Americans
known_for.overview: Set during the Cold War period in the 1980s, The Americans is the story of Elizabeth and Philip Jennings, two Soviet KGB officers posing as an American married couple in the suburbs of Washington D.C. and their neighbor, Stan Beeman, an FBI Counterintelligence agent.

results.title: Moti Mahal
results.overview: In the hilly state of Champa Nagar, the magnificent castle of Rai Saheb Motisagar called "MOTI MAHAL" stands there even today in all its regal glory. Our story springs from this historical palace whose ghastly memories make people shiver with fear even now. After Rai Saheb's sudden demise the rumour got currency that his restless spirit still hovered about the palace. Though nobody had any proof in support of this, but subsequent incidents gave substance to it. Just two days after his death, as his maid servant was bringing his only Son SUDHIR to Champa Nagar by train the child disappeared on the way. Hardly could the shock of this news subside, when one stormy night his nephew Jugal and sister's son Shekhar came together to  "MOTI MAHAL" to hear the WILL from Vakil. But Lo! the Vakil himself vanished and his dead body was picked up in the palace-compound, sometime later.

known_for.title: Baranda
known_for.overview: Girija's insecurities take over his mind as he suspects that his partner Runu is falling in love with a paying guest.

known_for.title: Parapaar
known_for.overview: Communication gaps surface when a man returns home after a 14 year prison term and is finally forced to take his tormentor head on

known_for.title: Kony
known_for.overview: A swimming coach who teaches swimming to underprivileged kids picks Kony from a slum of Calcutta and grooms her to be part of the Bengal swimming team to compete at the National Swimming Championship. However, politics, poverty and social stigma emerge as distinct roadblocks in their path.

results.title: Moti Bagh
results.overview: Vidyadutt Sharma has for decades nurtured his farm in a small Himalayan village. Around him, 7000 ghost villages bear chilling testimony to widespread migration for employment. Chronicling the changing landscape in verses of resistance, he persists, hoping to return Moti Bagh to its old glory.

known_for.title: When Night Falls
known_for.overview: Giora (Assi Dayan) runs a bar and dreams of opening a restaurant. He has made a mess of his life — his marriage is in trouble, since he is pathologically cheating on his wife; his parents (Yosef Millo and Orna Porat) have separated; and his father arrives for an extended visit from Nahariya. Giora spends time with his army buddies, recalling their experiences during the War in Lebanon. His father is undergoing a major life crisis and finds both the loneliness of the city and his son's lifestyle unappealing. As a non-Jew in a Jewish society, he feels estranged, an outsider who has never been able to adapt, and contemplates suicide. Eventually, Giora's parents decide to attempt a reconciliation, until tragedy strikes.

known_for.title: Molly's Game
known_for.overview: Molly Bloom, a young skier and former Olympic hopeful becomes a successful entrepreneur (and a target of an FBI investigation) when she establishes a high-stakes, international poker game.

known_for.name: The Expanse
known_for.overview: A thriller set two hundred years in the future following the case of a missing young woman who brings a hardened detective and a rogue ship's captain together in a race across the solar system to expose the greatest conspiracy in human history.

known_for.title: Twist
known_for.overview: In a gritty retelling of the Dickens's classic, Twist takes Oliver and the Artful Dodger out of the poorhouse and onto the streets, where junk is the currency and hustling is the game.

known_for.title: This Is Sodom
known_for.overview: When ancient Sodom is doomed to destruction due to its people's corrupt ways, Lot is the only righteous man destined to be spared.

known_for.title: To the Water Pits (El Borot Hamaim)
known_for.original_title: To the Water Pits (El Borot Hamaim)
known_for.overview: A onetime documentary directed by Moti Kirschenbaum who follows the history and the problems of living in the holy land. Following writer Amos Kenan and songwriter Naomi Shemer, the two discuss the meaning to live in the land of Israel.

known_for.title: Stories from the Savannah: A Journey to Tanzania
known_for.overview: Moti Kirschenbaum in a new film journey in Africa, his favorite continent. This time he travels in the Serengeti in Tanzania and meets deadly hippos, beautiful birds and two mothers, a cheetah and a tigress, who will do anything to provide food for their hungry cubs.
